test_text_generation_basic: test the text generation pipeline with simple prompts and do_sample options for deterministic and stochastic output
test_chat_completion_pipeline: test the text generation pipeline with chat message lists including system, user, and assistant roles using a chat template
test_stop_sequence_stopping: test the text generation pipeline with stop_sequence parameter to halt generation at a specified token sequence
test_assisted_generation_pipeline: test the text generation pipeline with an assistant model for speculative decoding and beam search incompatibility checks
test_pipeline_accelerate_dtype: test the text generation pipeline with accelerate device_map and dtype options for GPU inference with bfloat16 or float16
